summary.result: Comparing Euclidean distance with real road distance from village halls to medical facilities, real road distance appeared to be approximately 1.4 times that of Euclidean distance.
summary.background: The evaluation of accessibility uses Euclidean distance, in general; however, this method has its limits in that Euclidean distance cannot reflect actual distance.
summary.method: Using real road distance, we evaluated medical accessibility and compared it with Euclidean distance.
